svg.title: Toonverse wireframe 06: Drawing Canvas
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe, not a final UI design · Toonverse Task 011 (0.11) · Desktop-first (Issue #17 D5)
Size [----o-------] 12 Opacity [---------o] 100% Colour [#] 12 presets · last 8 used
Panel canvas · 800 px wide (D9) · height 200-2400 px
Rename, delete (asks if it has shapes),
move up and down, show/hide, lock.
Shortcuts: Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redo · hold Space to pan · Ctrl+S save.
Sandbox: your drawing is not saved. It is lost
when you leave this page. [Register to save]
No Save button, no save status and no draft
restore. Open to guests and users (Task 6.22).
Guest drawings are never saved or recovered (D1).
You're offline. Changes stay in memory and are
Recovery copy kept on this device.
Auto-save: 3 s after the last change, 30 s fallback.
Retry after 2, 4, 8 ... up to 60 s; at once when the
Leaving with unsaved work asks first (Task 8.12).
This panel was saved somewhere else.
Load the latest version or keep yours.
Keeping yours saves over the newer version.
Reused when a recovery draft is older than the server.
You have unsaved changes on this device.
Logged-in users only. Never offered to guests (D1, D10).
Free accounts can use 10 layers. Premium: 20.
The tool column becomes a bottom toolbar.
Layers and colours open as bottom sheets.
The canvas fits the screen width; zoom and pan
Touch and pen input are backlog (Tasks 6.24-6.25).
